user.title: Select İETT Tracking Mode
user.description: Choose a tracking profile to add. City-wide Traffic Index and Active Fleet Size sensors will be created automatically on first setup.

menu_options.root: Istanbul City-Wide Root Sensors (3 Traffic + 1 Fleet Size)
menu_options.stop: a) Add Stop (Enter/search stop code or name)
menu_options.route: b) Add Route (Enter/search route code or name)
menu_options.vehicle: c) Add Single Bus (Door No: strict X-NNNN format)

stop.title: Search Stop
stop.description: Enter the 6-digit stop code (e.g. 220602) or stop name (e.g. Besiktas Meydan).

stop_select.title: Select Stop
stop_select.description: Select a stop from search results:

stop_config.title: Stop Attributes & Filters
stop_config.description: Configure tracking parameters and entity attributes for {stop_name} ({stop_code}).

route.title: Search Route
route.description: Enter the route code (e.g. 500T, 14M) or name.

route_select.title: Select Route
route_select.description: Select a route from search results:

route_config.title: Route Options & Departures
route_config.description: Configure active buses, scheduled departures, and disruption announcements for {route_code}.

vehicle.title: Single Bus Tracking
vehicle.description: Enter the bus door number in strict X-NNNN format (e.g. C-1753, A-001). License plates are not accepted.
